eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World’s Strongest Sorcerer Participates in a Large Scale Magic Battle Tournament
eps.ov: Ray, Ariane, and Amelia form a team to participate in the Magicks War tournament. Now it's time to train!

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Dons a Mask... Again
eps.ov: Ray trains Ariane, while Lieselotte trains Amelia. Ray's mom also wants Ariane to get ahead in love?!

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Keeps Winning With His Team
eps.ov: Ray's team makes it to the finals of Magicks War, where they have to face Evi, Albert, and Lucas.

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer and His Friends Converse With Their Fists
eps.ov: It's Lucas vs Ariane and Amelia, and Ray vs Evi and Albert! Neither side is backing down, who is going to win?

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Goes on a Date With That Girl in a Foreign Land
eps.ov: Elisa is the 4th crown princess of Alpheria, and Ray has to assume the role of her boyfriend?!

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Faces the Incoming Trials
eps.ov: Ray has to endure more of Cathy's trials, but they pose no problem. But then Eugenics make a move...

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Carries an Underdeveloped Power
eps.ov: Ray suggests Cyril stands down, but he has a fark secret that allows him to fight against Ray...

eps.t: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Faces the New Students
eps.ov: New students have arrived at Arnold Academy. However, one of them, Nate Hoskins has a vendetta against Ray?
